verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent is API-first. The whole conversation runs over one WebSocket API, and agent configurations can be stored through the Console API. Account management is also exposed through the dg CLI, and an OpenAPI spec is published. However, nothing documents that every Console/UI capability is available through the API. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement or mapping, evidence that Console-only settings (billing, team/key management, analytics) are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Deepgram's Voice Agent API collapses that stack into a single, unified API.
